piece_type: DTC TV ad “TakING on TD Pool Out 1” (CP-VBZ-US-3838)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: [Visual] lengthy post-treatment segment in which protagonists continue their work without involuntary movements easily noticed by the viewer
cases.context: PI: AIMS change vs placebo -1.8 (40 mg, not significant after multiplicity) and -3.1 (80 mg) from baseline ~9.8–10.4.
cases.rationale: Near-complete resolution portrayed exceeds demonstrated benefit.
cases.check: Judge: post-treatment imagery vs. modest PI effect sizes on 0–28 scale.

cases.cat: Misleading presentation of study data (exploratory endpoint)
cases.claim: “…quickly reducING TD movements by greater than 5 times at 2 weeks.” | “ReducING TD Movements >5X at 2 WEEKS vs placebo.” | SUPER: “In a 6-week clinical trial, reductions based on average change from baseline to Week 2 ... INGREZZA (40 mg and 80 mg combined) -1.7 vs placebo -0.3.”
cases.context: Primary endpoint at Week 6; Week 2 was exploratory.
cases.rationale: Conclusions from exploratory early timepoint suggest earlier improvement than demonstrated.
cases.check: Rule: flag onset/early-timepoint claims where that timepoint is exploratory; flag ratio framing ('>5X') of small absolute changes.

cases.cat: Misleading presentation of study data (enriched population)
cases.claim: “98% of people were still satisfied with INGREZZA after 2 years.” | “Long-LastING Satisfaction >98% still satisfied after 2 YEARS.” | SUPER: “55 of 56 patients in a rollover study of patients taking INGREZZA for 48 weeks after completing long-term KINECT 3 & KINECT 4 studies...”
cases.context: Rollover study selected for responders; dissatisfied patients may drop out before PSQ.
cases.rationale: Enriched population results misrepresented as general experience.
cases.check: Judge: satisfaction/persistence stats from rollover/extension (completer) populations presented as generalizable.
